```{r prepare raw data}

# name rows by PTM
raw2 <- raw
rownames(raw2) <- raw2$PTM_collapse_key

# Remove QC samples
columns_to_remove <- c("X20230825_TIMS6_EVO4_PRI_X1009_P0276_R0899_44min_DIAphospho_S01_S2.A1_1_5023", "X20230825_TIMS6_EVO4_PRI_X1009_P0276_R0899_44min_DIAphospho_S94_S2.H10_1_5116", "X20230825_TIMS6_EVO4_PRI_X1009_P0276_R0899_44min_DIAphospho_S95_S3.A1_1_5117", "X20230825_TIMS6_EVO4_PRI_X1009_P0276_R0899_44min_DIAphospho_S168_S3.G2_1_5190")
raw_QCremoved <- raw2 %>%
    as.matrix() %>%
    .[, !colnames(.) %in% columns_to_remove, drop = FALSE] %>%
    .[-1, ]
# 47446 x 185

raw_QCremoved_df <- as.data.frame(raw_QCremoved)


```

```{r QC raw data}

# reliably identified sites
valid_rows_count <- sum(rowSums(!is.na(raw_QCremoved[, 1:164])) >= 10)
print(valid_rows_count)
# 41430 sites identified in at least 10 samples


# Phospho-proteins
if ("PG.ProteinNames" %in% colnames(raw_QCremoved_df)) {
    protein_names_column <- raw_QCremoved_df$PG.ProteinNames
    if (!is.null(protein_names_column) && length(protein_names_column) > 0) {
        unique_protein_names_count <- length(unique(protein_names_column))
        print(unique_protein_names_count)
    } else {
        print("Column 'PG.ProteinNames' is empty.")
    }
} else {
    print("Column 'PG.ProteinNames' not found in the dataframe.")
}
# 3.500


# missing values per sample
print(colCounts(raw_QCremoved[, 1:164], value = NA))


# detected sites per sample
detected_sites <- colSums(!is.na(raw_QCremoved[, 1:164]))
detected_sites <- as.data.frame(detected_sites)
detected_sites$samples <- row.names(detected_sites)
average_sites_per_sample <- detected_sites %>%
    summarise(avg_sites = mean(detected_sites, na.rm = TRUE),
              std_dev = sd(detected_sites, na.rm = TRUE))
print(average_sites_per_sample)
# avg_sites 19503.18, std_dev 1995.133
ggplot(data = detected_sites, aes(x = samples, y = detected_sites)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "lightblue3") +
    labs(title = "Sites per Sample", x = "Sample", y = "Sites detected") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 2, angle = 40, hjust = 1)) +  
    geom_hline(yintercept = average_sites_per_sample$avg_sites,
               linetype = "dashed", color = "maroon3") +  
    geom_text(aes(x = 1, y = average_sites_per_sample$avg_sites + 5),
              label = paste("Avg:", round(average_sites_per_sample$avg_sites, 2)),
              color = "maroon2", vjust = 1, hjust = 0) +
    geom_text(aes(x = 1, y = average_sites_per_sample$avg_sites - average_sites_per_sample$std_dev - 10),
              label = paste("SD:", round(average_sites_per_sample$std_dev, 2)),
              color = "blue", vjust = 0, hjust = 0)




# distribution of sites on Serine, Threonine or Tyrosine residues
AA_counts <- table(raw_QCremoved_df$PTM_0_aa)
print(AA_counts)
# s: 28758   t: 13854   y: 4834
AA <- as.data.frame(AA_counts)
AA$Var1 <- c("Serine", "Threonine", "Tyrosine")
ggplot(AA, aes(x="", y=Freq, fill=Var1)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", width=1, color="white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste(Var1, "
    ", Freq, "sites", sep = " ")), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)) +
    coord_polar("y") +
    theme_void() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("lightblue", "paleturquoise4", "turquoise4")) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
AA$Percentage <- AA$Freq / sum(AA$Freq) * 100
ggplot(AA, aes(x="", y=Percentage, fill=Var1)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", width=1, color="white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste(Var1, "\n", sprintf("%.2f%%", Percentage), sep=" ")), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)) +
    coord_polar("y") +
    theme_void() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("lightblue", "paleturquoise4", "turquoise4")) +

# variability in raw data: coefficient of variation
data <- raw_QCremoved_df[, 1:164] %>%
    dplyr::mutate_all(~ as.numeric(as.character(.))) 
cv_raw <- data |>
    dplyr::mutate(coefficient_variation = apply(data,
                                                1,
                                                FUN = function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(x, na.rm = TRUE) * 100)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(mean_LFQ = rowMeans(data, na.rm = TRUE))

median_cv <- median(cv_raw$coefficient_variation, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_cv <- mean(cv_raw$coefficient_variation, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("Median CV:", median_cv, "\n")
# Median CV: 63.2869 
cat("Mean CV:", mean_cv, "\n")
```

```{r log2}

# convert NA's and log2 transform the sample columns
log2 <- raw_QCremoved
log2[, 1:164] <- apply(raw_QCremoved[, 1:164], 2, function(x) {
    x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
    ifelse(!is.na(x) & x > 0, log2(x), NA)})

# rename sample columns 
log2_renamed <- as.data.frame(log2)
names(log2_renamed)[1:164] <- substr(names(log2_renamed)[1:164], 61, 64)
for (i in 1:nrow(Info)) {
    current_col_title <- Info$Current_Column_Title[i]
    additional_info <- Info$Group_Time_Cond_Participant[i]
    if (current_col_title %in% names(log2_renamed)) {
        names(log2_renamed)[which(names(log2_renamed) == current_col_title)] <- paste0(current_col_title, "-", additional_info)
    }
}

log2_renamed[, 1:164] <- lapply(log2_renamed[, 1:164], function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

# order of samples
samples_only <- log2_renamed[, 1:164]
# IMPORTANT: check that order of samples in matrix and metadata are the same
# first bring metadata (here: HIIT_Sample_Information in the same order as log2_QCremoved
column_order <- colnames(samples_only)
# match the "label" column in metadata with the column_order_DiffAnalysis
column_indices <- match(column_order, Info$label)
# reorder the the rows in metadata based on these indices
Info <- Info[column_indices, ]


```

```{r QC log2 data}
df <- log2_QCremoved[, 1:164]

df_complete <- df[complete.cases(df), ]

Info_order <- Info

Info_order$Combined <- factor(Info_order$Combined, levels = c("LeanPreBasal", "LeanPreInsulin", "ObesePreBasal", "ObesePreInsulin", "T2DPreBasal", "T2DPreInsulin", "LeanPostBasal", "LeanPostInsulin", "ObesePostBasal", "ObesePostInsulin", "T2DPostBasal", "T2DPostInsulin"))

# Order columns of complete based on the Combined column in Rename_basal
order_indices <- order(Info_order$Combined[match(colnames(df_complete), Info_order$label)])
df_complete_ordered <- df_complete[, order_indices]

correlation_matrix <- cor(df_complete_ordered, method = "pearson")

# Annotation for group
Info_order$Group <- ifelse(Info_order$Group == "Lean", 1, ifelse(Info_order$Group == "Obese", 2, ifelse(Info_order$Group == "T2D", 3, Info_order$Group)))
Info_order$Group <- as.numeric(Info_order$Group)
annotation_group <- data.frame(Group = Info_order$Group)
rownames(annotation_group) <- Info_order$label

# Annotation for Timepoint
Info_order$Timepoint <- ifelse(Info_order$Timepoint == "Pre", 1, ifelse(Info_order$Timepoint == "Post", 2, Info_order$Timepoint))
Info_order$Timepoint <- as.numeric(Info_order$Timepoint)
annotation_timepoint <- data.frame(Timepoint = Info_order$Timepoint)
rownames(annotation_timepoint) <- Info_order$label

# Annotation for Condition
Info_order$Condition <- ifelse(Info_order$Condition == "Basal", 1, ifelse(Info_order$Condition == "Insulin", 2, Info_order$Condition))
Info_order$Condition <- as.numeric(Info_order$Condition)
annotation_condition <- data.frame(Condition = Info_order$Condition)
rownames(annotation_condition) <- Info_order$label


annotation_col <- data.frame(
    Timepoint = annotation_timepoint,
    Group = annotation_group,
    Condition = annotation_condition)

pheatmap(correlation_matrix,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("lightpink", "white", "lightcyan", "lightskyblue1","lightskyblue3", "darkslateblue", "midnightblue"))(100),
         main = "Pearson Correlation Heatmap",
         cluster_rows = F,

         show_colnames = F,
         scale = "none",
         annotation_col = annotation_col,
         annotation_colors = list(

             Group = c("1" = "deepskyblue4", "2" = "purple4", "3" = "maroon3"),
             Condition = c("1" = "blue", "2" = "red")
         ))



pheatmap(correlation_matrix,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("pink3" ,"lightpink1", "lightpink", "mistyrose", "white", "lightcyan", "lightskyblue1", "darkslateblue"))(100),
         main = "Pearson Correlation Heatmap",

             Condition = c("1" = "blue", "2" = "red")
         ),
         breaks = seq(0.75, 1, length.out = 100))




# Exclude diagonal elements
correlation_values <- correlation_matrix[upper.tri(correlation_matrix)]

# Calculate statistics
min_corr <- min(correlation_values)
max_corr <- max(correlation_values)
median_corr <- median(correlation_values)
```

```{r SPSs normalization}

# load the SPSs dataset from PhosR reference Kim et al
#eg
#SPSs <- read_excel(here::here("data-raw/SPSs_for_correction_sentby.xlsx"))
colnames(SPSs) <- "SPsite"
SPSs$SPsite <- substr(SPSs$SPsite, 1, nchar(SPSs$SPsite) - 1)
SPSs$SPsite <- gsub(";", "_", SPSs$SPsite)

# make data compatible with SPSs format
log2_samples <- log2_renamed[, 1:164]



# do with imputed data and after SPSs un-impute so I have the full dataset normalized
log2_samples_mat <- as.matrix(log2_samples)
set.seed(12345)
saved.state <- .Random.seed
log2_samples_imputed <- impute.knn(as.matrix(log2_samples_mat))
imputed_matrix <- log2_samples_imputed$data
imputed_df <- as.data.frame(imputed_matrix)

# create mask for imputed values to locate the imputed values
imputed_mask <- (log2_samples != imputed_df)

# extract phosphosite labels
sites_imputed = rownames(imputed_df)
sites_imputed2 <- substring(sites_imputed, 1, nchar(sites_imputed) - 3)

# design matrix: one group to reduce bias
grps1 <- Info$replicate
design <- model.matrix(~grps1 - 1)

# ctl is an integer vector denoting the position of SPSs within the quantification matrix
SPSs_factor <- SPSs$SPsite
ctl_imputed = which(sites_imputed2 %in% SPSs_factor)

# make phosphoexperiment
ppe <- PhosphoExperiment(assays = list(Quantification = as.matrix(imputed_df)))
dim(ppe)
# 47446   164

# normalize data to stably phosphorylated sites
ppe_imputed_SPSs = RUVphospho(SummarizedExperiment::assay(ppe, "Quantification"),  M = design, k = 1, ctl = ctl_imputed)

grps <- gsub("^.{5}|_[0-9]{1,2}$", "", colnames(ppe_imputed_SPSs))

# plot PCA with imputed data
plotQC(ppe_imputed_SPSs, grps=grps, labels = " ", panel = "pca") +
    ggplot2::ggtitle("Imputed, After SPSs")

# extract dataframe from ppe
imputed_SPSsnorm_df <- as.data.frame(ppe_imputed_SPSs)

# Replace imputed values in the new dataframe with NA after SPSs normalization
unimputed_SPSsnorm_df <- imputed_SPSsnorm_df
unimputed_SPSsnorm_df[is.na(imputed_mask)] <- NA



```

```{r QC SPSs normalized data}
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
    theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
plotly::ggplotly(pca2)

# plot the Eigenvalues (% of variances explained by each component)
fviz_eig(pca_object_complete_unimputed_SPSsnorm,
         addlabels = T
) +
    theme_light() +
    ggtitle("Eigenvalues SPSs normalized on imputed data, 100% filtered") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```

```{r batch correction}

# Generate a SummarizedExperiment object using metadata
PhosphoSE <- PhosphoExperiment(assay = filt, colData= Info)
PCA_MS_raw <- plotMDS(assay(PhosphoSE), labels = PhosphoSE$BeatBoxBatch, main = "PCA before batch correction - SPSs normalized filtered")
PhosphoSE_BB <- PhosphoSE
assay(PhosphoSE_BB) <- removeBatchEffect(assay(PhosphoSE_BB), batch = PhosphoSE_BB$BeatBoxBatch)
plotMDS(assay(PhosphoSE_BB), labels = PhosphoSE_BB$BeatBoxBatch, main = "PCA after batch correction - SPSs normalized & filtered")

# extract dataset
phospho_dataset <- as.data.frame(assay(PhosphoSE_BB))


```

```{r Plots main_effect}

############################### FIGURE 4F & FIGURE 4A #############################

## volcano clamp main effect
volcano <- function(.data) {
    data_volcano <- .data %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
            significant = dplyr::case_when(
                adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0 ~ "significantly upregulated",
                adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < 0 ~ "significantly downregulated",
                TRUE ~ "not significant"
            )
        )

    p <- ggplot(data_volcano, aes(
        x = logFC,
        y = -log10(P.Value),
        color = significant,
        label = Site
    )) +
        geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c(
            "not significant" = "grey",
            "significantly downregulated" = "dodgerblue4",
            "significantly upregulated" = "firebrick4"
        ), name = "Significantly different") +
        theme_classic() +
        theme(
            text = element_text(size = 6, colour = "black"),
            legend.position = "none"
        )

    labels_to_show <- c(
        "AKT1S1_T246_M1",
        "TBC1D4_S341_M1",
        "AKT2_S474_M1",
        "IRS1_S270_M1",
        "SLC2A4_S10_M1",
        "TBC1D4_S754_M1",
        "RPS6KA3_S369_M2",
        "TBC1D4_S754_M1",
        "PLEC_S4396_M1",
        "FLNC_S2236_M1"

    )
    p <- p + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        data = dplyr::filter(data_volcano, Site %in% labels_to_show),
        aes(
            x = logFC,
            y = -log10(P.Value),
            label = Site,
            color = significant
        ),
        size = 2,
        min.segment.length = unit(0.1, "lines"),
        segment.size = unit(0.1, "mm"),
        force = 20,
        max.overlaps = Inf
    ) + scale_color_manual(values = c(
        "not significant" = "grey",
        "significantly downregulated" = "dodgerblue4",
        "significantly upregulated" = "firebrick4"
    ))

    return(p)
}
```

```{r Specific contrasts}
    levels = design_combined
)

# Define a function to extract the full table and count significant hits for a given comparison
extract_and_store_full_table <- function(fit, comparison_name, p_value_threshold = 0.05) {
    full_table <- limma::topTable(fit,
                                  coef = comparison_name,
                                  adjust = "BH",
                                  number = Inf)
    full_table$Site <- rownames(full_table)
    significant_table <- full_table[full_table$adj.P.Val < p_value_threshold, ]
    significant_table <- na.omit(significant_table)
    cat("Comparison:", comparison_name, " - Number of significant hits:", nrow(significant_table), "\n")
    assign(paste0(comparison_name), full_table, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    return(nrow(significant_table))
}

comparisons <- c("T2D_Lean_prebasal", "T2D_Lean_preinsulin", 
                 "T2D_Lean_postbasal", "T2D_Lean_postinsulin", 
                 "T2D_Obese_prebasal", "T2D_Obese_preinsulin", 
                 "T2D_Obese_postbasal", "T2D_Obese_postinsulin", 
                 "Obese_Lean_prebasal", "Obese_Lean_preinsulin", 
                 "Obese_Lean_postbasal", "Obese_Lean_postinsulin", 
                 "Lean_trainingBasal", "Lean_trainingInsulin", 
                 "Obese_trainingBasal", "Obese_trainingInsulin", 
                 "T2D_trainingBasal", "T2D_trainingInsulin", 
                 "Lean_clamp_pre", "Lean_clamp_post", 
                 "Obese_clamp_pre", "Obese_clamp_post", 
                 "T2D_clamp_pre", "T2D_clamp_post")

for (comparison in comparisons) {
    extract_and_store_full_table(fit2_combined, comparison)
}
```

```{r Boxplots}
sites <- c( "")


boxplots <- function(Sites, data, Info) {
    plots_list <- list() 
    
    for (site_name in Sites) {

        site_row <- data[site_name, , drop = FALSE]
        site_row_t <- t(site_row)  
        site_row_t <- as.data.frame(site_row_t)

        site_row_t$Combined <- Info$Combined
        site_row_t$Info <- factor(site_row_t$Combined, levels = c(
            "LeanPreBasal", "LeanPreInsulin", "LeanPostBasal", "LeanPostInsulin",
            "ObesePreBasal", "ObesePreInsulin", "ObesePostBasal", "ObesePostInsulin",
            "T2DPreBasal", "T2DPreInsulin", "T2DPostBasal", "T2DPostInsulin"
        ))
        site_row_t$Group <- Info$Group
        site_row_t$Timepoint <- Info$Timepoint
        site_row_t$Participant <- Info$Participant
        site_row_t$Condition <- Info$Condition


        color_fill <- c("Pre" = "white", "Post" = "mistyrose1")
        color_groups <- c("Lean" = "deepskyblue4", "Obese" = "purple4", "T2D" = "maroon3")

        point_size <- 0.01
        line_size <- 0.2
        fatten_median <- 0.8

        plot <- ggplot(site_row_t, aes(x = Info, y = !!sym(site_name), color = Group, fill = Timepoint)) +
            geom_boxplot(outlier.size = point_size,outlier.alpha = 0.5, size = line_size, fatten = fatten_median) +
            geom_point(size = point_size, alpha = 0.2, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.5)) +
            geom_line(aes(group = Participant, colour = Group), size = 0.1, alpha = 0.4) +
            labs(title = paste("", site_name)) +
            scale_fill_manual(values = color_fill) +
            scale_color_manual(values = color_groups) +
            theme_classic() +
            theme(
                legend.position = "none",
                text = element_text(size = 6),
                axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
                plot.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold")
            )
        
        plots_list[[site_name]] <- plot
    }

    combined_plots <- do.call(grid.arrange, c(plots_list, ncol = 1))

    return(combined_plots)
}

plots <- boxplots(Sites = sites, data = phospho_dataset, Info = Info)
```

```{r Group specific training effects, overlapped with proteome}

## load proteome data (group specific training effect toptables), eg:
#Obese_trainingBasal_proteome <- load(here::here("data/Obese_trainingBasal.rda"))
#Lean_trainingBasal_proteome <- load(here::here("data/Lean_trainingBasal.rda"))
#T2D_trainingBasal_proteome <- load(here::here("data/T2D_trainingBasal.rda"))
#Obese_trainingInsulin_proteome <- load(here::here("data/Obese_trainingInsulin.rda"))
#Lean_trainingInsulin_proteome <- load(here::here("data/Lean_trainingInsulin.rda"))
#T2D_trainingInsulin_proteome <- load(here::here("data/T2D_trainingInsulin.rda"))

# Function to process proteome and phospho data
process_proteome_phospho_data <- function(proteome_file, phospho_file) {
    # Load Proteome data dynamically
    proteome_data_env <- new.env()
    load(proteome_file, envir = proteome_data_env)
    proteome_data <- proteome_data_env[[ls(proteome_data_env)[1]]]  # Extract loaded object dynamically

    # Identify significantly up/down-regulated proteins
    proteome_up <- proteome_data %>% filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0) %>% pull(Protein)
    proteome_down <- proteome_data %>% filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < 0) %>% pull(Protein)

    # Load Phosphoproteome data dynamically
    phospho_data_env <- new.env()
    load(phospho_file, envir = phospho_data_env)
    phospho_data <- phospho_data_env[[ls(phospho_data_env)[1]]]  # Extract loaded object dynamically

    # Ensure a "Protein" column exists by extracting from "Site"
    if ("Site" %in% colnames(phospho_data)) {
        phospho_data$Protein <- sub("_.*", "", phospho_data$Site)
    } else {
        stop("Column 'Site' not found in phospho data. Check dataset format.")
    }

    # Process Phospho data
    phospho_data <- phospho_data %>%
        mutate(
            Phospho_regulation = case_when(
                adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0 ~ "up",
                adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < 0 ~ "down",
                TRUE ~ "NA"
            ),
            Proteome_regulation = case_when(
                Protein %in% proteome_up ~ "sig_up",
                Protein %in% proteome_down ~ "sig_down",
                TRUE ~ "NA"
            ),
            Phospho_Proteome_regulation = paste(Phospho_regulation, Proteome_regulation, sep = "_and_")
        )

    # Return processed data and table counts
    return(list(data = phospho_data, counts = table(phospho_data$Phospho_Proteome_regulation)))
}
```

```{r sites normalized to proteins}
# Define a function to extract the full table and count significant hits for a given comparison
extract_and_store_full_table <- function(fit, comparison_name, p_value_threshold = 0.05) {
    full_table <- limma::topTable(fit,
                                  coef = comparison_name,
                                  adjust = "BH",
                                  number = Inf)
    full_table$Site <- rownames(full_table)
    significant_table <- full_table[full_table$adj.P.Val < p_value_threshold, ]
    significant_table <- na.omit(significant_table)
    cat("Comparison:", comparison_name, " - Number of significant hits:", nrow(significant_table), "\n")
    assign(paste0(comparison_name), full_table, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    return(nrow(significant_table))
}

boxplots <- function(Sites, data, Info) {
    plots_list <- list() 
    
    for (site_name in Sites) {

        site_row <- data[site_name, , drop = FALSE]
        site_row_t <- t(site_row)  
        site_row_t <- as.data.frame(site_row_t)

        site_row_t$Combined <- Info$Combined
        site_row_t$Info <- factor(site_row_t$Combined, levels = c(
            "LeanPreBasal", "LeanPreInsulin", "LeanPostBasal", "LeanPostInsulin",
            "ObesePreBasal", "ObesePreInsulin", "ObesePostBasal", "ObesePostInsulin",
            "T2DPreBasal", "T2DPreInsulin", "T2DPostBasal", "T2DPostInsulin"
        ))
        site_row_t$Group <- Info$Group
        site_row_t$Timepoint <- Info$Timepoint
        site_row_t$Participant <- Info$Participant
        site_row_t$Condition <- Info$Condition


        color_fill <- c("Pre" = "white", "Post" = "mistyrose1")
        color_groups <- c("Lean" = "deepskyblue4", "Obese" = "purple4", "T2D" = "maroon3")

        point_size <- 0.05
        line_size <- 0.2
        fatten_median <- 0.8

        plot <- ggplot(site_row_t, aes(x = Info, y = !!sym(site_name), color = Group, fill = Timepoint)) +
            geom_boxplot(outlier.size = point_size, size = line_size, fatten = fatten_median) +
            geom_point(size = point_size, alpha = 0.6, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.8)) +
            geom_line(aes(group = Participant, colour = Group), size = 0.1, alpha = 0.5) +
            labs(title = paste("", site_name)) +
            scale_fill_manual(values = color_fill) +
            scale_color_manual(values = color_groups) +
            theme_classic() +
            theme(
                legend.position = "none",
                text = element_text(size = 6),
                axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
                plot.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold")
            )
        
        plots_list[[site_name]] <- plot
    }

    combined_plots <- do.call(grid.arrange, c(plots_list, ncol = 1))

    return(combined_plots)
}

plots <- boxplots(Sites = sites, data = InputNorm_wide_filter, Info = Info)
```

```{r KEA}
volcano_kinase <- function(.data) {
    data_volcano <- .data %>%
        dplyr::filter(enrichment_value_log2 >= 0) %>%  # Filter for x >= 0
        dplyr::mutate(
            significant = dplyr::case_when(
                adjusted_p_value < 0.05 & enrichment_value > 0 ~ "significantly enriched",
                TRUE ~ "not significant"
            ),
            label = dplyr::case_when(
                adjusted_p_value < 0.05 ~ as.character(kinase),
                TRUE ~ ""
            )
        )

    plot <- ggplot(data_volcano, aes(
        x = enrichment_value_log2,
        y = adjusted_p_value_log10_abs,
        color = significant
    )) +
        geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
        ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
            aes(label = label),
            color = "seagreen",
            size = 2,
            min.segment.length = 0.01,
            segment.size = 0.1,
            force = 20,
            max.overlaps = Inf
        ) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c('grey', 'seagreen'), name = "Kinase Enrichment") +
        theme_classic() +
        theme(
            text = element_text(size = 6, colour = "black"),
            legend.position = "none"
        ) +
        labs(
            x = "log2 (Enrichment value)",
            y = "-log10 (Adjusted p-value)"
        )

    return(plot)
}
```
